versions.title: Pond runs on NixOS
versions.summary: Pond's shell, lock screen, wallpaper, screenshot preview and launcher packaged from our forks and offered as a second login session next to DMS. Pond's own runtime (Qt 6.12, Quickshell 0.3.2) comes from a pinned nixos-unstable; DMS is untouched. Captured from a nested preview on Bonhart; not yet activated.

versions.title: First real login: pure Pond
versions.summary: The first login to the Pond session on Bonhart showed DMS's bar, dock and wallpaper over Pond, because librepods.service (started by every graphical session) wants dms.service. dms.service now skips itself while the Pond session runs. The laptop panel stays on in Pond by choice.

captures.title: Real session, both displays
captures.note: Laptop panel (left) with the first-run manual; the KVM display (right) with the bare Pond desktop.

versions.title: Our own desktop: looks and taste
versions.summary: Pond's session dropped as not ready; Pond stays as a reference in pond-preview. Direction: one native, coherent desktop with Azure Folio's colors and Pond's form. The parity board is archived and replaced by a taste board; looks (before, folio) switch the live DMS session's shape, motion, translucency and depth from the workshop page. Studies: a kit (folio.css, folio.js) and seven screens; Pond and Azure Folio are no longer named as styles.
